title: Geometric short exact sequence for integral ideal patching
statement: Let $X$ be locally Noetherian and quasi-compact [pqf-def-locnoeth, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions], and $i:Z\to X$ a closed immersion with $Z$ integral [def-weil-closed-immersion, def-pc-integral-scheme]. Let $\xi$ have closure $i(Z)$. Let $P$ be any property of modules with $P(0)$, and suppose there is a coherent $G$ with support $i(Z)$ and $\mathfrak m_\xi G_\xi=0$ [def-weil-residue-field], such that for every quasi-coherent ideal inclusion $J\hookrightarrow\mathcal O_X$ generically surjective at $\xi$, there is a coherent subobject $G^\prime\subseteq G$, factoring through $JG\hookrightarrow G$ [lem-weil-pbc-ideal-module-product-stalk], generically surjective and satisfying $P(G^\prime)$. For each quasi-coherent ideal $I$ on $Z$ [def-sbc-closed-immersion-ideal-sheaf], there exist $r\ge1$ and a short exact sequence $H\to (i_*I)^{\oplus r}\to Q$ of coherent modules [pqf-def-coherent], with $i_*I$ coherent, together with a coherent $G^\prime$ with $P(G^\prime)$ and an isomorphism $H\cong G^\prime$. Moreover $\operatorname{Supp}(Q)\subseteq i(Z)$ and $Q_\xi=0$ [def-weil-pbc-module-stalk]. No extension closure, finite-sum descent or hypothesis asserting $P(Q)$ is assumed.

proof.text: Ideal modules and their closed pushforwards are coherent, by the locally Noetherian and finite-pushforward results. The zero ideal case uses rank one, zero submodule and zero quotient, with G prime zero and P(0).

The generic point η of Z maps to ξ by [lem-weil-pbc-scheme-sober] and the closed embedding. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-coherent-generic-point-ideal-inclusion] to G: obtain a mono from i_*(I^{⊕r}) into G which is an isomorphism near ξ. Since Supp(G)=i(Z), G_ξ is nonzero, so r≥1 and I is nonzero. For every nonzero ideal I′≤I, its generic stalk inclusion is bijective by [lem-weil-pbc-integral-scheme-ideal-generic-stalk]. Sectionwise pushforward commutes with finite sums. Its composite β:(i_*I′)^{⊕r}→G is a mono, bijective at ξ by naturality [lem-weil-pbc-closed-pushforward-stalks].

For a nonzero ideal I on Z, intersect it with the nonzero ideal A supplied by the generic inclusion. Embed its positive sum in G. Form its coherent cokernel Q0 and its annihilator J; J is quasi-coherent and has unit stalk at ξ. JG factors through the sum because J kills Q0. The hypothesis on G supplies a coherent G prime inside JG with full generic stalk and P(G prime). Pull it back through the mono into G to obtain an isomorphic coherent module H.

The intersection is nonzero because products of nonzero sections on a nonempty affine open in the integral scheme are nonzero. Include H through the intersection sum into the specified biproduct of i_*I. Its cokernel Q is coherent, supported in i(Z) and vanishes at ξ by stalk exactness. The kernel-cokernel short complex is short exact and has the specified middle object. This construction never invokes extension closure, positive-sum descent, or a small-support property of P.
